title: Budget F# reference discovery-failure details without discarding partial results
outcome: F# reference discovery failure details remain within the response budget while successful lower-bound counts and aggregate failure reasons stay available.
acceptance: A workspace with many unevaluatable F# projects returns a bounded discoveryFailed sample with selected/returned/omitted coverage and a stable omission reason.
The response remains within Json.HardBudgetBytes and does not fall back to the unrelated FCS reference-identity overflow message.
